article.headline: Kanaan Carlyle scores 20 to lead Florida Atlantic over Long Island University 74-60 in opener
article.description: — Kanaan Carlyle's 20 points helped Florida Atlantic defeat Long Island University 74-60 on Monday night.
article.linkText: Kanaan Carlyle scores 20 to lead Florida Atlantic over Long Island University 74-60 in opener

categories.description: Long Island University Sharks @ Florida Atlantic Owls

event.description: Long Island University Sharks @ Florida Atlantic Owls

keywords: Long Island University Sharks @ Florida Atlantic Owls
article.story: BOCA RATON, Fla. -- — Kanaan Carlyle's 20 points helped Florida Atlantic defeat Long Island University 74-60 on Monday night. Carlyle added nine rebounds and five steals for the Owls. Josh Harris had 15 points and six rebounds. Felipe Quinones shot 7 of 12 from the field to finish with 14 points. Daquan Davis finished with 16 points for the Sharks. Kamari Jones added 13 points and Vasean Allette totaled nine points, five assists and three steals. Florida Atlantic took the lead for good with 9:19 remaining in the second half. Carlyle had 13 points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
